methods.arm: arm({caseId,requestId,action,maximumFrames,maximumBytes?,maximumMs}) -> readProof(); finite packet-gap/drop-next-delta, packet-delay/delay-downstream, slow-client/pause-downstream only; at most3 unique arms, one active
methods.accept: acceptServerFrame(originalBytes:Uint8Array,{isBinary:boolean,isDelta:boolean}) -> readProof(); opaque complete genuine server frame <=65546 bytes; Root owns boundaries and canonical C05 classification, never JSON guessing
methods.dispose: dispose() closes/retire once, clears queued bytes/timer, never resumes after abort/unknown outcome

callbacks.send: SYNCHRONOUS send(exactBytesCopy,{isBinary}) -> void|true; false/throw/thenable uncertain, retire+close; no second send after uncertainty. Measured delivered means synchronous sink handoff, NOT endpoint receipt. Root additionally owns actual socket writable-buffer limits and asynchronous failure cleanup.
callbacks.pauseResume: Synchronous actual pauseUpstream()/resumeUpstream(); void|true success, false/throw/thenable uncertainty. pause can yield zero extra buffered frames. Utility counts callback completion; genuine I/O effect still needs qualified Root attachment.
callbacks.close: close() must close the same real owned pair; no extra connection. Exceptions recorded only as fixed closeFailed boolean.
callbacks.timers: now is monotonic milliseconds. Default performance.now/setTimeout/clearTimeout. Delay/pause schedules release up to10ms BEFORE hard deadline to allow timer dispatch; observed late callbacks/frames retire, never silently extend. Effects and actual completion timestamps must remain <=hard bound.

bounds.packet-gap: drop exactly one Root-classified genuine delta within <=1000ms; other frames byte-preserved; no-delta expiry closes as failed/no effect
bounds.packet-delay: <=8 frames /262144 actual provided bytes /250ms; copies prevent later caller mutation; FIFO exact byte values/binary flags
bounds.slow-client: actual pause/resume <=1000ms; buffer only arriving in-flight <=64 frames/262144 bytes; FIFO flush before resume. This is not a claimed Rust queue measurement.

privacy: No frame contents, ticket/Auth/control payload, principal bodies, headers, callback exception messages or handles in proof. Root supplies only application frame/classification inputs; it handles control frames separately.
ownership: Root153 STOP-to83 only new frame-faults.mjs + frame-faults.test.mjs under already assigned prefix. Root retains actual Vite server/WS upgrade/proxy/cohort/checkpoint composition. No server/new upstream/endpoint in utility. First25path3bac handoff preserved as separate cohort.
requiredRuntime: Fresh actual Root relay/window/finite allocation + literalACCEPT + bothguards. No actual capability/current descriptor/browser outcome implied by source cases.
